text: The fix edits a shared file explicitly reserved for T-MG-21 by brief.md:10, which requires a local fake instead. reason: Scope-coordination finding of T-MG-24 r2 (shared fake-at.ts reserved for T-MG-21 while both ran). Both tasks are merged on main and the full suite is green, so the conflict it guarded against cannot happen any more; the 6 added lines are a test helper, not product code.
